user.title: Create backup profile
user.description: Choose the basic profile settings first. The next step only shows the fields needed for the selected schedule.

data_description.profile_name: A recognizable name, such as “Daily NAS backup”.
data_description.backup_type: Full includes all supported data. Partial lets you choose Home Assistant and add-ons.
data_description.schedule: Daily runs every day. Weekly runs on one selected weekday. Interval runs every N days from a chosen date.

details.title: Configure backup details
details.description: Only settings relevant to the schedule selected in the previous step are shown. After saving, use the “Run backup now” button to test the profile and selected storage location.

data_description.time: The local time at which scheduled backups start.
data_description.weekdays: The one weekday on which the weekly backup starts.
data_description.interval_days: Number of days between interval backups.
data_description.anchor_date: The first date from which the interval is calculated.
data_description.retention: Only this number of confirmed backups made by this profile is kept. At least one confirmed backup is always retained.
data_description.location: Local storage or an active Supervisor backup mount, such as a NAS location.
data_description.addon_mode: Include only the selected add-ons, or include all installed add-ons except the selected ones.
data_description.addons: The add-ons to include or exclude, according to the selection mode.
data_description.include_homeassistant: Include the Home Assistant configuration and data in a partial backup.
data_description.exclude_database: Do not include the recorder database. Available for partial backups only.
data_description.password: The shared code is stored by the integration and is not shown in profile attributes. Use the “show encryption code” button on a plan device when you explicitly need to see it.
data_description.notify_success: Create a persistent Home Assistant notification when this profile finishes successfully.
data_description.notify_failure: Create a persistent Home Assistant notification when a run needs attention.
data_description.encryption_mode: Create one encryption code shared by all backup plans. Generate creates a strong code automatically; Manual lets you enter your own code.

error.invalid_interval: Enter a valid interval and start date.
error.invalid_addon_mode: Select a valid add-on selection mode.
error.database_requires_homeassistant: The database requires Home Assistant to be included.
